name: Harvest Ridge Winery
blurb: A winery on the Maryland line at Marydel, open seven days with a tasting room and outdoor space. The only one of these that publishes what it does about dogs, and it's a yes.

dogs.note: The winery's own wording: "Friendly, leashed dogs are always welcome in our outdoor areas." It says nothing about the tasting room, so assume outside.

tasting: $25 for a tasting with a tour, six wines. $15 for a flight of four you choose.

onSite.label: Outdoor areas
onSite.note: Where the dogs go. The winery names them as the dog-friendly part without describing them further.

onSite.label: A second site
onSite.note: There's a Pennsylvania tasting room at Toughkenamon with its own hours. Don't drive to the wrong one.

warnings: Marydel straddles the state line. The winery is on the Delaware side; the town name belongs to both.

sources.label: Harvest Ridge Winery: visit
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Westville Road address, the phone number, tasting room hours for both locations, the $25 tour-and-tasting and $15 flight prices, and the dog policy quoted above.

outstanding: Ask whether dogs are allowed in the tasting room itself, or outdoor areas only.
Confirm whether the outdoor area is covered — it decides the answer on a wet day.
Confirm whether food is served or whether it's wine only.

name: Thompson Island Brewing Company
blurb: A brewery with a fifteen-barrel brewhouse, wood-fired food and a large beer garden, minutes from the Rehoboth beach. Open every day, late.

dogs.note: The brewery publishes no dog policy. Several guides say the outdoor tables are dog friendly; none of them is the brewery.

onSite.label: Beer garden
onSite.note: The brewery calls it spacious. There's a fire pit.

onSite.label: Food
onSite.note: Wood-fired, with seasonal specials. This is a restaurant as much as a taproom.

onSite.label: Music
onSite.note: Live, on the brewery's own account.

warnings: No published dog policy. If the dog is the reason you're going, ring 302-226-4677 first.

sources.label: Thompson Island Brewing Company
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Veterans Way address, the phone number, daily 11:30am to 10pm, the 4-6pm happy hour, the beer garden, fire pit, wood-fired food and live music. States no dog policy anywhere.

outstanding: Ring and get the dog policy. Every aggregator asserts one and the brewery publishes none.
Confirm whether the beer garden is covered or heated out of season.

name: Mispillion River Brewing
blurb: A Milford taproom open seven days and late on weekends — midnight-ish on a Friday, which almost nothing else in Kent County manages.

dogs.note: The brewery publishes no dog policy.

warnings: No published dog policy. Ring 302-491-6623 before you bring one.

sources.label: Mispillion River Brewing
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Mullet Run Street address, the phone number and the full week of taproom hours. States no dog policy.

outstanding: Ring and get the dog policy.
Confirm whether there's outdoor seating at all.
Confirm whether food is served or whether it's beer only.

name: Nassau Valley Vineyards
blurb: Delaware's first winery, in the fields behind Lewes. Tastings, tours, and a farmers' market on the site. It publishes almost nothing else about visiting, including its hours.

dogs.note: The winery publishes no dog policy.

hoursNote: The winery does not publish opening hours on its own site. Ring 302-645-9463.

onSite.label: Farmers' market
onSite.note: Run on the winery's own site. Days not published.

warnings: No published hours and no published dog policy. This is a ring-ahead, not a turn-up.

sources.label: Nassau Valley Vineyards
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Winery Way address and the phone number, describes tastings, tours, event hire and a farmers' market, and calls itself Delaware's first winery. Publishes no opening hours, no tasting fee and no dog policy. Note the https address redirects to http.

outstanding: Get the opening hours. They are not on the site at all.
Ring and get the dog policy.
Confirm which days the farmers' market runs.
